description: Reports building activity in Portuguese municipalities. It gives our monthly count of building-works cases entering licensing, where we collect them, and INE's yearly licensed buildings and new dwellings for all 308. Use it for building activity; for other figures use `municipality_stats`. Without `municipality` it returns every municipality we collect and the panel index. `measure` and `granularity` change only our own series. A case is not a granted licence or a building.

granularity.description: Period of our own series; the INE series is yearly either way

language.description: Language of the page links and labels; the text summary and field names stay English. uk is accepted as ua.

measure.description: Kind of works counted in our own series: all works, new buildings, or alterations and extensions

municipality.description: Optional. Municipality name in any case, accents optional (Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos; Lisbon and Oporto are accepted) or its four-digit code (1312). Close spellings are found; two matches return an `ambiguous` error with candidates. Omit for the summary of every municipality we collect

name: construction_barometer

anyOf.description: Without municipality: every municipality we collect, and the index.
With municipality: our series (if collected) and INE's yearly series.

outputSchema.description: Success, or a refusal with an error code. Units: *_cents euro cents, *_eur euros, *_eur_m2 euros per m², *_pct and percent in percent.

title: Construction activity by municipality (barometer)
